```{r}
#| label: setup
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)

food_report <- read.csv("C:/Users/winni/Documents/class2/restaurant report/food_report_clean.csv")
```

## Row {height="10%"}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Total transactions in dataset"
#| icon: 
#| color: warning
list(value = nrow(food_report))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Median of transaction amount in dataset"
#| icon: 
#| color: primary
list(value = round(median(food_report$transaction_amount, na.rm = FALSE)))
```

## Row {height="45%"}

### Column {width="33%"}

```{r}
#| title: "1.Transactions of each time period"
food_report %>%
  count(time_of_sale, item_type) %>%
  mutate(item_type = factor(item_type, labels = c("Beverages", "Fastfood"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(time_of_sale), y = n, fill = item_type)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  labs(x = "Time Period", y = "Number of Transaction", fill = "Item type")
```

### Column {width="33%"}

```{r}
ggplot(food_report, aes(x = factor(time_of_sale), y =  transaction_amount)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(x = "Time period", y = "Transaction amount", title = "2.Transaction amount of each time period")
```

### 

## Row {height="45%"}

### Column {width="50%"}

```{r}

fastfood_data <- food_report %>%
  filter(item_type == "Fastfood") %>%
  group_by(time_of_sale) %>%
  summarise(total_quantity = sum(quantity, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")


ggplot(fastfood_data,
       aes(x = time_of_sale, y = total_quantity)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    title = "3.Fastfood Sales by Time",
    x = "Time of Sale",
    y = "Total Quantity"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Column {width="50%"}

```{r}
beverages_data <- food_report %>%
  filter(item_type == "Beverages") %>%
  group_by(time_of_sale) %>%
  summarise(total_quantity = sum(quantity, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

ggplot(beverages_data,
       aes(x = time_of_sale, y = total_quantity)) +
  geom_col(fill = "red", alpha = 0.65) +
  labs(
    title = "4.Beverages Sales by Time",
    x = "Time of Sale",
    y = "Total Quantity"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
